content.comment_body: Hello, Devices: [product_name] [article_no] | [product_name] [version_no] KTP-400 HMI | TIA Portal [version_no] I'm currently using timers in my program, such as Off-Delay timers. The timer output values are displayed in seconds or milliseconds by default. I'd like users to set and view timers on the HMI using hours and minutes (hh:mm) rather than raw seconds. My approach is to create User Defined Functions in [product_name] to perform conversions between seconds and the hh:mm format. I use mathematical instructions for this. Is there a simpler method for automatic conversion, either in [product_name] or directly within TIA Portal HMI? Thank you...

I'm not certain if the display format for time values can be changed on the HMI. Within [product_name], there aren’t built-in blocks for this type of time conversion, so it typically has to be programmed manually.

I don't believe you can directly compare your time with a base time in [product_name], but certain programmable logic controllers do offer solutions. For [version_no] versions, you can set the remaining time from the HMI interface. Please refer to the attached file.

analysis.insight_summary: Users working with automation devices from [company_name] face a challenge: timer outputs are shown only in seconds or milliseconds, whereas many prefer a more understandable format like hh:mm or hh:mm:ss on HMI screens. There are no built-in features to support this display or input format, which means users must write their own conversion logic using mathematical instructions or user-defined functions. This limitation impacts usability both in programming tools and HMI integration.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want an easy and automated way to display and input timer values in standard time formats (hh:mm or hh:mm:ss) within programming environments and HMI interfaces, without needing manual conversion or custom programming.
